items: Equilibrium ki halat sirf reversible reactions par lagoo hai.
Equilibrium sirf tab qaim ho sakta hai jab reaction ka bartan band ho, taake reactants ya products ka koi hissa na nikle.

blocks.text: CaCO3(s) se CaO(s) + CO2(g) ke liye equilibrium band system mein qaim hota hai, jahan carbon dioxide solids ke rabte mein rehti hai, magar khule system mein nahi, jahan gas nikal jati hai aur dobara nahi mil sakti.

blocks.alt: Do bartan jin mein CaCO3(s) ki surkh, CaO(s) ki hari aur CO2(g) ki chhoti surmai golian hain. (a) Band bartan: neeche CaCO3 aur CaO ka mixture aur oopar CO2 qaid. (b) Oopar se khula bartan: taqreeban sara thos CaO ban chuka aur CO2 munh se nikal rahi hai. Har bartan ke neeche CaCO3(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO2(g). Neeche nishanon ki key.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.2: (a) Band nizam mein equilibrium qaim hota hai (b) Khule nizam mein equilibrium qaim nahi ho sakta (kitab ki Figure 8.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Soda water ki botal mein gaseous CO2 hal shuda CO2 ke saath equilibrium mein hai, CO2(g) + H2O(l) se HCO3-(aq) + H+(aq). Is equilibrium ke liye dhakkan band kyun hona chahiye, aur dhakkan hatane par yeh kis taraf shift hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Dhakkan lage hone par solution se nikalne wali CO2 botal mein rehti aur usi rate se dobara halti hai, to system band hai aur equilibrium qaim rehta hai. Dhakkan hatane se gas nikal jati hai; reverse reaction ke paas milane ko kuch nahi rehta, to equilibrium baen shift hota hai, hal shuda CO2 bulbulon ke taur par nikalti rehti hai, aur mashroob phika ho jata hai.

items: Equilibrium ko reversible reaction aur band bartan chahiye; CaCO3 aur CO2 sirf tab equilibrium pate hain jab gas nikal na sake.
